jobs.title: Armed Patrol Specialist – Elite Retail Security (Plano)
jobs.description:
Allied Universal is hiring an Armed Security Officer Elite Patrol Unit for a full-time role in Plano, TX. The officer will monitor and patrol a busy retail location, provide customer service, maintain safety, and deter security incidents while reflecting Allied Universal values.
